1.name: T
1.text: Came to talk ya ear off again, hope ya don’t mind?

2.name: T
2.text: Just kidding, I wouldn’t come here just for that.

3.name: T
3.text: But I don’t like talking with just my girls, they agree with me too much.

4.name: T
4.text: You look like a resolute, no-nonsense, serious woman.

7.name: T
7.text: So, this time It’s nothing to do with my teacher...

9.name: T
9.text: It was morning and I was just getting to class, yeah?

10.name: T
10.text: But then out of nowhere, some crazy girl starts screaming and getting up to my face...

11.name: T
11.text: Talking about how I was trying to steal her man or something?

12.name: T
12.text: Like, girl? First of all, I don’t even know the guy she’s talking about.

13.name: T
13.text: Second, I talk to whoever I want, whenever I want, and she has no shit to say for that.

14.name: T
14.text: And third, if she thinks that anyone not blind is eyeing her out, then she gots to get her mirror checked, because ain’t no way someone’s got the flutters for a skank-face like that!

16.name: T
16.text: Of course, I didn’t say ALL that, but the point came across.

17.name: T
17.text: So now, I’m pretty tempted to just go and talk to the boy she was talking about in the first place.

18.name: T
18.text: Just to stir up some trouble, yeah?

20.name: T
20.text: Hey, not my fault she started acting crazy!

21.name: T
21.text: I ain’t scared of nothin’, don’t you worry.

22.name: T
22.text: But I'm blabbing too much already.

27.name: T
27.text: Look, you remember yesterday when I talked about a creep?

28.name: T
28.text: It’s a weird-ass feeling, but I honestly think I’ve been getting followed around recently.

30.name: T
30.text: But I can’t prove it, you know?

31.name: T
31.text: It’s really, really fucking weird, but there’s nothing I can do.

32.name: T
32.text: I tried talking to the police, but since I don’t know anything about the other person... can’t gravitate a police officer around a 17-year old all day.

33.name: T
33.text: My parents don’t care about it, they think I want attention or an excuse to pay for a car instead of taking the bus.

36.name: T
36.text: It’s not like I did anything to anyone, why would I be getting followed?

37.name: T
37.text: They want something with me. And for that, I’m scared.

39.name: T
39.text: But I ain’t backing out, I got some pride in me.

40.name: T
40.text: I felt better talking to you about this, so thanks much!
